shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && find .agents -type f && echo ---- && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && cat CLAUDE.md && cat package.json 2>/dev/null

cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120 && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo ---- && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh && echo ---- && find src __agent_eval__ -type f && cat index.html src/* 2>/dev/null; cat tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

grep -n -i "page-constructor\|page constructor" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -20; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | head -30; echo ----; npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30

sed -n 400,424p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; curl -s -m 20 https://gravity-ui.com/llms/page-constructor/8/llms.txt | head -c 200 || echo "fetch failed"; echo; curl -s -m 20 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://gravity-ui.com/llms/page-constructor/8/llms.txt

npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor@^8 2>&1 | tail -15; echo ----; node -e 'console.log(require("./node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json").version)'; cat package.json | grep -A12 '"dependencies"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/dist 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build 2>/dev/null | head

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/* | head -50; ls node_modules/@diplodoc 2>/dev/null; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -150
D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs; sed -n 150,260p $D/INDEX.md; echo ----HERO; cat $D/blocks/Hero.md; echo ----HEADER; cat $D/blocks/Header.md | head -150

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs; cat $D/blocks/ExtendedFeatures.md | head -120; echo ----BANNER; cat $D/blocks/Banner.md | head -90; echo; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ ; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "^sass|diplodoc|dynamic-import"

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; ls $P/styles | head; echo ----; grep -rl "import(" $P/build/esm --include=*.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo ----; find $P/build -name "*.d.ts" | grep -i -E "provider|index.d.ts" | head; echo ----; grep -rn "ButtonBlock\b" $P/build/docs/*.md $P/README.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; echo ----; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -E "^(sass|tsc|vite)$"; echo; cat $P/package.json | grep -E '"(main|module|types|exports)"' | head; grep -n -A8 '"sass\|"scss' $P/package.json | head -20

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; wc -c $P/styles/styles.css $P/styles/styles.scss; head -c 600 $P/styles/styles.css; echo; echo ----; cat $P/styles/styles.scss | head -30; echo ----; node -e 'const p=require("./node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json"); console.log(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(p.exports)), JSON.stringify(p.exports["./styles/*"]||p.exports["./styles/styles.css"]||null))'; echo ----; grep -n "PageConstructorProvider" -A12 $P/build/esm/index.d.ts | head -5; find $P/build/esm -name "*.d.ts" | xargs grep -l "PageConstructorProvider" | head -3

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm; cat $P/containers/PageConstructor/Provider.d.ts; echo ----; cat $P/containers/PageConstructor/index.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; grep -rn "ButtonBlock\b" $P --include=*.d.ts | head -3; echo ----; grep -rn "theme" $P/blocks/ExtendedFeatures/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls $P/blocks | head -40

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm; sed -n 933,960p $P/schema/validators/common.d.ts; echo ----; cat $P/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructor.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ----; grep -n "theme" $P/blocks/Header/schema.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "centered\|width" $P/blocks/Header/schema.d.ts | head -5

npm install -D sass 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -3; node -e 'console.log("sass", require("./node_modules/sass/package.json").version)'; node -e 'console.log("uikit", require("./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json").version, "pc", require("./node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json").version)'; ls node_modules/@diplodoc/ ; git status --short
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -40

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor; head -20 $P/build/esm/utils/url.js; echo ----; grep -rn "from ['\"]url['\"]" $P/build/esm --include=*.js | head; echo ----; grep -rn "~@" $P/styles/*.scss | head; echo ----; grep -rln "from ['\"]url['\"]\|require(['\"]url" $P/build/esm/index.js $P/build/esm/blocks/Header 2>/dev/null | head -3
P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm; grep -n "parse(\|format(" $P/utils/url.js; echo ----; grep -rln "utils/url.js" $P --include=*.js | head -20

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm; sed -n 30,50p $P/utils/url.js; echo ----; grep -rn "from '\./url\|from \"\./url\|/url.js'\|utils/url'" $P --include=*.js | grep -v "^$P/utils/url" | head -10; echo ----; grep -n "export" $P/utils/url.js

P=node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm; grep -rln "getAbsolutePath" $P --include=*.js | head; echo ----; grep -rn "getAbsolutePath(" $P --include=*.js | grep -v "utils/url.js" | head -5
npm install url 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -2; node -e 'console.log("url", require("./node_modules/url/package.json").version, Object.keys(require("./node_modules/url")))' ; ls node_modules/url

npm run build > /tmp/build.log 2>&1; echo "build exit=$?"; grep -c -i "deprecat" /tmp/build.log; grep -i "error" /tmp/build.log | head -3; tail -2 /tmp/build.log; ls dist/assets | head; grep -o "Учёт времени[^<]*" dist/index.html | head -2

NODE_PATH=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules ./node_modules/.bin/esbuild /tmp/ssrcheck/entry.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --jsx=automatic --outfile=/tmp/ssrcheck/out.cjs --loader:.scss=empty --loader:.css=empty --log-level=warning --resolve-extensions=.tsx,.ts,.js,.jsx,.json 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "bundle exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; node /tmp/ssrcheck/out.cjs 2>&1 | head -40
rm -rf dist /tmp/ssrcheck /tmp/build.log && git status --short && echo ---- && git diff -- index.html package.json && echo ---- && cat vite.config.ts

npm run build > /tmp/final-build.log 2>&1; echo "build exit=$?"; grep -i "error" /tmp/final-build.log | grep -v "npm warn" | head -3; tail -1 /tmp/final-build.log; rm -rf dist /tmp/final-build.log; git status --short | head -3
